website.note: Teleflex is a medical device company; no drug pipeline page applicable. Public site is product-focused.

commercial_product.note: Teleflex is a global provider of medical technology / single-use medical devices used in high-acuity emergent procedures (vascular access, interventional, anesthesia, surgical, urology including UroLift, emergency medicine, respiratory). Revenue is essentially all from cleared/approved devices, not from drug or biologic candidates.

excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT04794348 — Phase 2 freeze-dried plasma non-inferiority trial (Teleflex-led) — WITHDRAWN.
excluded_partner_owned: NCT07292818 — Phase 1 hyaluronic-acid gel spacer in gynecologic malignancies. Investigator-initiated, lead sponsor UNC Lineberger Comprehensive Cancer Center; Teleflex listed only as collaborator. Asset is not a Teleflex proprietary drug candidate.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Teleflex is a medical-device company (single-use surgical, vascular access, urology including UroLift, anesthesia, respiratory, emergency medicine). It has no proprietary drug or biologic pipeline. ClinicalTrials.gov shows only 2 records: one Teleflex-led trial that was WITHDRAWN, and one investigator-initiated study where Teleflex is merely a collaborator. No active proprietary P1/P2/P3 drug or pivotal-IDE device development programs disclosed in the FY2025 10-K.
